name: Miyasaka Kaori
source:
[url=/c106116]Miyasaka Yuuka[/url]'s mother. She has a laid back personality, so it's unsurprising that she accepts the protagonist as a guest at her home. Kaori seems to know something about Miyuki, but seems reluctant to talk about this.

 [Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010625112432fw_/http://www.din.or.jp/~syscom/ange/new/eternity/index.html]official website[/url].]
